description: A well-specified feature request should produce a spec without asking questions.

fixture.issueBody: Add an optional due date field to each todo item. The API should accept an ISO-8601 date string in the `dueDate` field when creating or updating a todo. The UI should show the due date next to each item and highlight overdue items in red. Items with no due date should display normally.

rubric.description: Triage returns 'draft' rather than 'ask' for a clear request
The spec contains at least one acceptance criterion
The spec mentions the dueDate API field
